description:
Presidential Secretariat - an essential Public Service to the life of the community
 1. All services Connected to the supply of Electricity.
 2. The supply or Distribution of petroleum Produces and fuel
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal order issued by the President under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It declares specific services (electricity supply and petroleum distribution) to be essential public services, which constitutes a regulatory action. While it mentions the President by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - instead, it exercises statutory powers to create a legal framework for essential services regulation, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
